text:
Les 110 de Taillevent looks like the best fit. Its Lamennais private room seats 6 to 10, it's about 0.2 miles from Oxford Circus, and it offers a lunch menu and group menus. Harry's Marylebone has a private room and a £26 two-course set lunch, but that price was listed only through 27 November. I haven't confirmed availability for the 18th.
